headline: Rivian faces class action lawsuit over misleading self-driving claims
summary: Plaintiffs claim Rivian overstated capabilities of R1T and R1S
details: Rivian has been sued on allegations that it made misleading statements about the self-driving capabilities of its R1T truck and R1S SUV.
Plaintiffs claim the company overstated the capabilities of the R1T and R1S, representing that early models would be capable of level 3 autonomous driving.
The complaint states that Rivian manufactured its Gen 1 Vehicles without the hardware, cameras, sensors, and compute to enable hands-free driving and/or Level 3 autonomous operation.
caption:
Rivian sued over self-driving claims

Rivian has been sued on allegations that it made misleading statements about the self-driving capabilities of its R1T truck and R1S SUV.

Plaintiffs claim the company overstated the capabilities of the R1T and R1S, representing that early models would be capable of level 3 autonomous driving.

The complaint states that Rivian manufactured its Gen 1 Vehicles without the hardware, cameras, sensors, and compute to enable hands-free driving and/or Level 3 autonomous operation.

headline: Apple to stream next Formula 1 Grand Prix for free on Apple TV
summary: The next Formula 1 race will stream for free on Apple TV in the US.
details: The next Formula 1 race will stream completely for free on the Apple TV app in the United States. No subscription or login is required.
This is a one-time offer and it's not clear if future races will be available for free.
